$comment: Every subagent emits exactly this shape to reviews/raw/<reviewer>.json. The orchestrator merges on it, so deviations break the merge.

findings.title: One line, under 80 chars, states the defect
findings.why: 2-3 sentences. What breaks, and the concrete path to it.
findings.evidence: The exact offending line(s), verbatim from the file.
findings.fix: The specific change. Show code when it is under 6 lines.
findings.rule: Style guide rule number, CWE id, or null

clean: files or areas checked and found acceptable
